section1.title: 1. Who provides this service
section1.p1: ServiçoOS is operated by ADRIEL WELLINGTON RODRIGUES, registered under CNPJ No. 53.325.011/0001-08, hereinafter referred to as “ServiçoOS,” “we,” or “provider.”
section1.p2: By creating an account or using the system in any way, you (the “user” or “customer”) agree to these Terms of Use and to our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>. If you do not agree with any part of them, please do not use the service.

section2.title: 2. What ServiçoOS is
section2.p1: ServiçoOS is a management system (SaaS) for service companies, offering, among other features: client management (CRM), quotes, service orders, financial management, scheduling, a real-time technician location map, checklists and digital signatures, electronic service invoice issuance (NFS-e), and WhatsApp integration.
section2.p2: The service is provided “as is” and may be updated, modified, or have features added or removed at any time, always seeking to maintain or improve the user experience.

section3.title: 3. Registration and account
section3.p1: To use ServiçoOS you must create an account with true, complete, and up-to-date information about yourself and your company. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity that occurs on your account.
section3.p2: Each account represents a company (“tenant”) and can have multiple users with different permission levels ({owner}, {admin}, {technician}), controlled by the account owner.

section4.title: 4. Free trial period
section4.p1: New accounts are entitled to a 15-calendar-day free trial, with no credit card required, with full access to the features of the available subscription plan. This period may be extended by additional days through the referral program (section 7).
section4.p2: At the end of the trial period, if no plan has been purchased, access to the system's features is blocked until a paid plan is purchased — registered data remains saved and is automatically restored as soon as a plan is subscribed to.

section5.title: 5. Plans, payment, and billing
section5.p1: The available plans, prices, and included features are shown on the <planosLink>plans</planosLink> page and in the subscription area within the system, and may be adjusted upon prior notice.
section5.p2: Payments are processed by a payment partner (gateway) and can be made via bank slip or credit card, on a monthly or annual cycle. ServiçoOS does not store complete credit card data — processing is handled entirely by the payment partner.
section5.p3: Billing is recurring and automatic according to the chosen cycle, until the subscription is cancelled. In the event of payment failure or delay, access may be suspended until the situation is resolved.

section6.title: 6. Cancellation and refunds
section6.p1: You may cancel your subscription at any time directly through the system's subscription area, with no penalty. Cancellation stops automatic renewal; access to paid features remains available until the end of the period already paid for.
section6.p2: Amounts already paid for current periods are not refunded, except where required by law or by ServiçoOS's express commercial decision.

section7.title: 7. Referral program
section7.p1: Users can refer ServiçoOS to third parties through an exclusive link. Whoever signs up through a referral earns extra days of free trial; whoever refers someone earns extra days of subscription when the referred person purchases a paid plan. The current details and amounts are shown in the system's referral area and may be adjusted at any time, with no retroactive effect on benefits already granted.

section8.title: 8. Your data and your clients' data
section8.p1: All content you enter into the system — client records, service orders, financial data, quotes, documents, and attachments — belongs to you or your company. ServiçoOS acts solely as a processor of this data, storing and processing it to enable the system to function, as detailed in our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
section8.p2: You are responsible for ensuring that you have an appropriate legal basis and consent to enter third-party data (your clients, technicians, and suppliers) into the system.
section8.p3: Our team's access to your account. To provide technical support, investigate failures or fix issues you report, authorized members of our team may access your account and view the data it contains. Such access is limited to those purposes and follows these rules:
section8.i1: Granted only to authorized staff, by specific role, and revoked immediately upon termination;
section8.i2: Every access is recorded in an audit log identifying who accessed it, which company, and the date and time;
section8.i3: The support session expires automatically after 1 hour;
section8.i4: Our staff are bound by a contractual confidentiality obligation;
section8.i5: We do not use your account data for any purpose beyond the requested support or service maintenance.
section8.p4: You may request, at any time, the history of support accesses performed on your account, through the contact email listed at the end of these Terms.

section9.title: 9. Acceptable use
section9.intro: By using ServiçoOS, you agree not to:
section9.item1: Use the system for illegal purposes or in ways that violate third-party rights;
section9.item2: Attempt to access data belonging to other companies (tenants) without authorization;
section9.item3: Attempt to bypass the system's technical, security, or usage limits;
section9.item4: Reverse engineer, copy, or resell the system without authorization;
section9.item5: Use the system to send spam or unsolicited communications via WhatsApp/email.

section10.title: 10. Service availability
section10.p1: We make reasonable efforts to keep the system available and functioning properly, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted availability (100% uptime). Scheduled maintenance, instability of third-party providers (hosting, database, payment gateway), or force majeure events may cause temporary unavailability.

section11.title: 11. Intellectual property
section11.p1: The software, brand, design, and other elements of ServiçoOS are the property of the provider identified in section 1. The user is granted only a non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable license to use it, limited to the term of the subscription.

section12.title: 12. Limitation of liability
section12.p1: To the fullest extent permitted by law, ServiçoOS is not liable for indirect damages, loss of profits, or loss of data resulting from misuse of the system, failures in the user's internet connection, or unavailability of integrated third-party services (payment gateway, email provider, WhatsApp, invoice issuer).
section12.p2: We recommend that users keep their own copies/backups of especially sensitive documents and data, in addition to the backups maintained by ServiçoOS.

section13.title: 13. Termination
section13.p1: ServiçoOS may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms of Use, with prior notice when possible. Users may terminate their account at any time by contacting our support channel.

section14.title: 14. Changes to these terms
section14.p1: We may update these Terms of Use periodically. Material changes will be communicated by email or notice within the system. Continued use after a change implies agreement with the new terms.

section15.title: 15. Governing law and jurisdiction
section15.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. The courts of the judicial district of the provider identified in section 1 are elected to settle any disputes arising from these Terms, with waiver of any other, however privileged it may be.

section16.title: 16. Contact
section16.p1: Questions about these Terms of Use can be sent to <email>olisuporte1@gmail.com</email>.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how ServiçoOS collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data, in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018 — LGPD).

section1.title: 1. Who is the data controller
section1.p1: The controller of the personal data processed by this system is ADRIEL WELLINGTON RODRIGUES, registered under CNPJ No. 53.325.011/0001-08, operator of ServiçoOS.

section2.title: 2. What data we collect
section2.userDataItem1: Name, email, and password (stored encrypted, never in plain text);
section2.userDataItem2: Phone number, CPF/CNPJ, and company address (when provided);
section2.userDataItem3: Tax data for invoice issuance (CNPJ, municipal registration number, ISS tax rate).
section2.systemDataLabel: Data entered by the user while using the system:
section2.systemDataItem1: Client, provider, and technician records (name, contact information, address, ID document);
section2.systemDataItem2: Service orders, quotes, attachments, photos, and clients' digital signatures;
section2.systemDataItem4: Geographic location (GPS) of technicians, collected during work hours to display on the service order tracking map;
section2.systemDataItem5: Messages and phone number used in the WhatsApp integration, when enabled.
section2.autoDataItem1: Essential session/authentication cookies (we do not use advertising tracking cookies);
section2.autoDataItem2: Technical access logs (IP address, date and time, pages accessed), for security and diagnostic purposes.

section3.title: 3. What we use the data for
section3.intro: We use the data we collect for the following purposes:
section3.item1: Enabling the system and the contracted features to function (contract performance);
section3.item2: Authenticating access and protecting accounts against unauthorized use;
section3.item3: Processing payments and issuing invoices and charges;
section3.item4: Sending operational communications (registration confirmation, billing, trial expiration, team invitations) and, when applicable, satisfaction surveys (NPS);
section3.item5: Displaying field technicians' location to the {owner}/{admin} of the contracting company, exclusively while using the system;
section3.item6: Complying with legal and regulatory obligations, including tax and accounting requirements;
section3.item7: Preventing fraud and ensuring platform security.

section4.title: 4. Who we share data with
section4.p1: We do not sell personal data. We share strictly necessary data with service providers (processors) who help us operate ServiçoOS:

table.zapi: WhatsApp messaging integration (when enabled by the company)

section4.p2: We may also share data when required by law, court order, or to protect the rights, safety, or property of ServiçoOS or third parties.

section5.title: 5. International data transfer
section5.p1: Our core infrastructure (database and hosting) is located in data centers in the São Paulo, Brazil region. Some of the processors listed in section 4 are international companies that may process data in other countries as part of their global operations. In such cases, we seek to use processors with data protection practices compatible with the LGPD.

section6.title: 6. How long we keep data
section6.p1: We keep data for as long as your account remains active. Tax and financial data may be retained for an additional period to comply with legal obligations (generally 5 years, under Brazilian tax law). After the account is closed and the legal retention periods have elapsed, data is deleted or anonymized.

section7.title: 7. Your rights as a data subject
section7.intro: Under Article 18 of the LGPD, you have the right to:
section7.item1: Confirmation that processing exists and access to your data;
section7.item2: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data;
section7.item3: Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data or data processed in noncompliance with the law;
section7.item4: Portability of your data to another service provider;
section7.item5: Deletion of data processed with your consent (except where legal retention applies);
section7.item6: Information about the entities with which your data has been shared;
section7.item8: Review of decisions made solely on the basis of automated processing.

section8.title: 8. How to exercise your rights
section8.p1: The account owner (Owner profile) can download a copy of all company data at any time, on a self-service basis, under Settings → Export data. For other rights (correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent, clarifications), contact us at <email>olisuporte1@gmail.com</email> — this is also the contact channel for ServiçoOS's data protection officer (DPO). We will respond within a reasonable time, as required by the LGPD.

section9.title: 9. Information security
section9.p1: We adopt technical and administrative measures to protect personal data, including encrypted passwords, secure connections (HTTPS/TLS), permission-based access control, and data isolation between different companies (tenants). Despite these efforts, no system is 100% immune to incidents — in the event of a significant security incident, we will notify data subjects and the competent authority as required by the LGPD.

section10.title: 10. Cookies
section10.p1: We use only essential cookies, necessary to keep your session authenticated and to ensure the system functions properly. We do not use advertising or social media tracking cookies.

section11.title: 11. Children's data
section11.p1: ServiçoOS is a professional/business tool and is not directed at minors. We do not knowingly collect data from children or teenagers.

section12.title: 12. Changes to this policy
section12.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated by email or notice within the system, with the date at the top of this page updated accordingly.

section13.title: 13. Data Protection Officer (DPO)
section13.p1: For all matters related to personal data protection, the data protection officer can be contacted at <email>olisuporte1@gmail.com</email>.

items.title: Automatic Receipts
items.desc: Generate professional PDF receipts after every payment, with signature and full details.

items.title: Internal Maintenance
items.desc: Track fleet and internal equipment maintenance separately from client service orders.

items.text: I cut 3 hours of administrative work a day. The system is very easy to use and my team loved it.
My clients love getting the service order PDF with the digital signature. It looks so much more professional.
The GPS map changed my life. I know where every technician is in real time, without having to call them.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent plans
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits the size of your team. Cancel anytime.
pricing.disclaimer: All prices in BRL. Billed via boleto or credit card.

items.q: Is there a free trial period?
items.a: No — you need to subscribe to one of our plans to use the system. We accept boleto or credit card, with payments processed securely through Asaas.
Yes, no fees and no red tape. You can cancel right from your own dashboard in seconds.

items.q: Does the system work on mobile?
items.a: Yes! ServiçoOS is a PWA (Progressive Web App) — it works on your phone like a native app, with nothing to install from an app store.

items.q: How many users can I have?
items.a: Up to 3 on Starter, up to 10 on Pro, and unlimited on Enterprise. Each user can have different permissions (owner, admin, or technician).

items.q: Which municipalities does e-invoice (NFS-e) issuance support?
items.a: The integration runs through nfe.io, which supports more than 5,000 Brazilian municipalities. It's configured in the system's tax settings.
Yes. Your data is stored on Supabase (AWS infrastructure) with encryption, automatic backups, and LGPD compliance.

nps.scaleHint: 0 = would not recommend · 10 = would definitely recommend

banner.title: No connection.

neverSubscribed.title: Subscribe to a plan to get started
neverSubscribed.desc: ServiçoOS has no free trial — choose one of the plans below to unlock access to the system.

pending.title: Confirming your payment
pending.desc: We received your subscription and are waiting for payment confirmation. It usually takes just a moment — as soon as it clears, your access is unlocked automatically.

cancelled.title: Subscription cancelled
cancelled.desc: Your subscription was cancelled. To restore access, subscribe to a new plan. All your data is still saved.

pastDue.title: Payment overdue
pastDue.desc: We found a problem with your payment and the grace period has ended. Update your billing details to restore access immediately.

dataBox.title: What happens to my data?
dataBox.item1: All your data is saved and secure
dataBox.item2: Once payment clears, access is restored immediately
